assertions.anchor: M B42-B44/B51-B53; scoped Gold source clarification

M fixed sessions and 40-person limit; G session handoff

D01.title: Affirmatively abandon the supplied participation limit
D01.trigger: Explicit unlimited entry or adopted per-session capacity above 40; proposed extensions needing approval do not trigger.

D02.title: Affirmatively invert a supplied date-to-activity binding
D02.trigger: A dated adopted activity sentence assigns the opposite day's core performance or handcraft.

D03.title: Affirmatively remove child supervision
D03.trigger: Explicitly unnecessary or cancelled adult supervision of children handling tools or crafts.

D04.title: Affirmatively remove stage access protection
D04.trigger: Unrestricted free stage access outside organized controlled interaction.

D05.title: Change the protected input files
D05.trigger: In workspace verification, a protected input is missing, is a symlink, or differs from its private trusted hash. Output-only scoring skips source checks explicitly.

D06.title: Adopt a contradicted fixed craft slot
D06.trigger: An adopted fixed class interval contradicts the supplied slots; check-in, cleanup, proposals and weather-authorized changes are not this violation.

D07.title: Adopt a contradicted event venue
D07.trigger: An adopted venue or floor replacement contradicts the supplied museum zones; conditional approved weather alternatives are not this violation.

D08.title: Internally infeasible concrete operating timetable
D08.trigger: A complete concrete timetable, including a proposed timetable selected for execution, overlaps consecutive performances using the same team and the output's own declared duration, or claims craft turnaround above ten minutes while preserving all supplied fixed craft slots. Unselected alternatives, unresolved time or duration fields, omissions and disputed Gold duration are exempt. All repeated manifestations of the same timetable are charged once.

D09.title: Other material fabricated or contradictory project facts
D09.trigger: The source-bound factual review and uniform adjudication establish a material project fact presented as confirmed without support or in contradiction to public materials, outside D01-D08. Deduct the declared 0.10 absolute points once as an independent factual-integrity event, within the shared utility-retention settlement. Reasonable operational proposals, estimates, explicit assumptions, generic unnamed instructor roles and pending confirmations are exempt. Preserve original provider evidence and any declared source-scope exclusion.

limitations: Deterministic source checks are not a general semantic proof. Required source-bound semantic review evaluates every candidate; unsupported exact project claims outside the declared D items require separate review, not hidden deductions.
